name: Pho
description: Pho is a traditional Vietnamese noodle soup known for its aromatic broth, tender meat, and fresh herbs.
fun_fact: Pho originated in Northern Vietnam in the early 20th century and has since become a national dish, loved worldwide for its comforting and flavorful qualities.
instructions: Rinse beef bones and boil them for 5 minutes to remove impurities. Drain and rinse again.
In a large pot, add the cleaned bones, charred onion, charred ginger, cinnamon stick, star anise, cloves, cardamom pod, coriander seeds, salt, and sugar.
Fill the pot with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 6-8 hours, skimming off any foam that rises to the top.
Strain the broth and discard the solids. Season with fish sauce to taste.
Soak rice noodles in warm water until softened, then drain.
Bring the broth to a boil and add the rice noodles. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the thinly sliced beef to the broth and let it cook for a few seconds until just done.
Ladle the soup into bowls, ensuring each bowl has noodles and beef.
Garnish with fresh herbs, bean sprouts, lime wedges, and sliced jalapeños.
